summary: An item being destroyed waits for its destruction animation (seen in the fight with S_FOR_Bottomless_Ettercap_02, items/webs broken). esv::item::DestructionSystem adds it with a 20 s timeout and, each frame, finishes the destruction when the timeout runs out or the flag at +0 is set.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x33CDB40 sets +4 = 20.0f (0x41A00000) after adding it; bg3.exe+0x33CF4B0 subtracts the frame time and proceeds when <= 0; live 20.0
